decision.reason: [ev-a6197708b375] only says per-broker storage class overrides are "not supported anymore" and tells users to move to multiple KafkaNodePool resources. It does not say what happens to an existing configuration that still uses them. The overrides could be silently ignored (setting-ignored), the resource could be rejected (resource-rejected), or reconciliation could fail, so the choice of setting-ignored is not proven. To decide, we need the 0.46.0 CRD schema diff for the overrides field, or the operator documentation or code showing how leftover overrides are handled.
